primary.title: An Autobiography or The Story of My Experiments with Truth
primary.author: Mahatma Gandhi
primary.rationale: Gandhi's autobiography is a foundational text for understanding his life, philosophy, and political activities. It is widely available in digital formats.

primary.title: Hind Swaraj or Indian Home Rule
primary.author: Mahatma Gandhi
primary.rationale: This seminal work outlines Gandhi's vision for India's independence and his critique of Western civilization. It is a key text for his political thought.

primary.title: The Collected Works of Mahatma Gandhi
primary.author: Mahatma Gandhi
primary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of Gandhi's writings, speeches, and letters, offering unparalleled depth for research. While the full collection might be extensive, individual volumes or selections are often digitized.

secondary.title: Gandhi: A Political and Spiritual Biography
secondary.author: Peter Rühe
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography by a respected scholar, offering a detailed analysis of Gandhi's life and impact.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Gandhi
secondary.author: Judith M. Brown and Anthony Parel
secondary.rationale: An edited collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Gandhi's thought and legacy, providing diverse scholarly perspectives.

secondary.title: Gandhi's Political Philosophy: A Critical Examination
secondary.author: M. M. Sankhdher
secondary.rationale: An early scholarly analysis of Gandhi's political philosophy, offering critical insights into his ideas and their application.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are selected based on their foundational importance and likelihood of digital availability. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly merit and publication date.
